purpose: Small exact diagnostics of the reduction, not a theorem/novelty certificate.

checks.name: covariant tensor L2 squared rescaling
checks.detail: Under q=c^-1 g the exponent is c^(2-n/2)=1 at n=4.

checks.name: Clarke dimension-four coefficient
checks.detail: sqrt(4)/4=1/2; applying path length bound gives the same all-subset error.

checks.name: normalized path derivative
checks.detail: After multiplying by c^2: c^2 qdot=-2c Ric+6g=-2c(Ric-3g/c).

checks.name: square-root subdivision
checks.detail: R/r=eta^(1/8)=D^(1/16); log term is strictly subleading.

checks.name: fixed model does not dominate
checks.detail: eta^(1/3) is smaller than eta^(1/8) for eta in (0,1).

checks.name: spectral scale and product inverse
checks.detail: CP2 Ric6 -> Ric3 halves eigenvalues; product Ric1 -> Ric3 triples; negative product mode is not zero.
